steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ha, ha... Holy crap, how are there still so many...

The wind grows more violent. Coarse sand grains scrape against her skin, leaving red marks. Her Sinner power works hard to heal her, but it can't keep up with the rate of her injuries. Struggling to swing her pipe, she's barely holding on.
The sky darkens, and the desert bandits who are still attacking start to panic.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Minion
steps.content: Boss, we're not gonna make it! The wind's getting stronger! It's the <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color>! We should retreat!
The wind roars. The desert bandit leader glares viciously at Hella, then finally waves his hand to signal retreat.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Ptui! You think you can run away? Without the protection of Hypercubes, you'll all die in the sandstorm!
The roar of the sand ship's engine fades away, and Hella finally collapses onto the ground.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ow, my arm... If I fought any longer, I'd have lost...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But the sandstorm's coming. That Tide of Ashes is no joke. I can't stay here. I gotta tell the Tuco folks to get out...
In the earlier battle, most of Tuco's residents retreated to the town center under Hella's cover. Now that the bandit threat has been cleared, they must escape the town before the storm hits.
Hella stumbles towards the square and spots a bunch of busy figures in the distance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Quick, the desert bandits have left! The Tide of Ashes or something is coming! We have to leave! I'll help you pack, I...

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Alright, everyone speed up! We need to make a run for it!
A familiar voice, a familiar figure.
The Tuco townsfolk are deftly straddling the low wall, struggling to haul a large, strange box with all their might. Hella bursts into the square, and everyone freezes, their eyes fixed on her...
In the middle of the crowd pushing the big box is the one who had just "fled in panic"... Korryn.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yo, Hella darling! I'm back to save the day! Ready to make a dash?
Korryn salutes Hella without a hint of embarrassment.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Why are you here? Trying to trick us again?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mira, don't let her fool you, this bastard...

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Ahahaha, well, um...
Mira lets out an awkward chuckle. Hella's death glare sweeps the square, causing a few townsfolk to guiltily avert their gaze and look at the large box instead.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What is this?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Just a bit of... luggage we borrowed from the bandits?
Another gust of wind blows through, and the welcome sign at the town gate crashes to the ground. The noise jitters the townsfolk, causing them to drop the box onto the ground.
A few blue Hypercubes tumble out, rolling slowly to Hella's feet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the hell! A den of thieves!!! You're all in on it!!

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Don't say that, little lady! We're not like the desert bandits! They're a "faceless" bunch, who ain't know nothing about "law 'n otter".

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: But we... are the "caterpillars" of building a better tomorrow! We'll "conspire" this together!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bullcrap! There's no "we" in this! And I am not a bug! You are!

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Hehe, well, it's an emergency... How about I share some of my goods with you? One Hypercube? Two? I can't give you more than that, or else I won't have enough!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You think I care about splitting the damn loot?! Huh?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh dear, it's not good for kids to swear! Swearing will stop you from growing tall!
The more she tries to soothe Hella, the angrier Hella gets. She curses and stomps, charging at Korryn with a flurry of punches. But Korryn blocks the attack and tries to explain in a softer tone.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The direction of the wind has changed, and the sandstorm will hit soon. The sand ships here aren't as good as the ones in DisCity, so someone had to prepare in advance without alerting the bandits.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Problem was, not many people in Tuco can fight. I had to get to the ship, but someone also had to hold off the bandits...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Luckily, with you here, we gained enough time to retreat with an adequate Hypercube supply... Now that we're fully prepared, let's set off!
After her long-winded explanation, Korryn waits for Hella's wrath, but it doesn't come as expected.
Hella lowers her head, her expression unreadable and her fist freezing three inches away. Korryn scratches her head and cautiously bends down.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Still mad, little hero?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh dear, I really planned to stay and fight with you... Look, I came running back to pick you up as soon as I finished.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: There, there. If we linger any longer, we'll really be swallowed up by the sand. Come with us, okay?
Hella angrily slaps away Korryn's outstretched hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Get lost!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bounty hunter my ass! WhiteSands town my ass! I came back because I was so worried about you guys! What a fool I was!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You... you're all nothing but a bunch of scammers!! Using me as a shield to save your own hide, huh?! Shameless!! Screw you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'd rather be buried in the sand than believe another word you say!
Korryn is shocked. She wants to say something, but her gaze suddenly shifts to behind Hella, and her expression changes dramatically.
At that moment, a fierce windstorm starts to rage.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The sandstorm has arrived early!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Everyone, grab onto something heavy and go to the sand ship! If you get blown away, you're done for!
There's no time to activate the shield. The howling sandstorm swallows up everything. As Hella gets pushed to and fro by the wind, she sees someone reaching out to her through the sand.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Damn it... hold on to me!
Hella vaguely sees a group of people running towards her. Korryn at the front looks uncharacteristically anxious. She tries to grab Hella, but only manages to pinch the edge of her clothing.
Hella tries to hold on... but the wind grows stronger, and the fabric serving as their connection flutters precariously.
Hella gets swept away by the raging sandstorm! Before losing consciousness, she vaguely hears Korryn shouting something.
What is she saying? Are these people good or just as bad as the desert bandits? Everything is so blurry in the raging sand. Hella can neither see nor tell.
Her consciousness gradually blurs, then fades into darkness.
Hella wakes up not on rough sand, but on a rather soft bed. The hum of machinery sounds around her. She's clearly not in the sandstorm anymore.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What's going on? Didn't I get buried in the sand...
She doesn't know how long she's been unconscious. Her injuries have mostly healed. Not opening her eyes all the way, Hella sneaks a peek through her eyelashes...

Sure enough, she's lying in a sand ship. Hella recognizes the ship's design. It's similar to the one from the Outland Affairs Bureau on her last trip to WhiteSands. The people around are wearing DisCity uniforms.
Footsteps approach. Hella quickly shuts her eyes tight, but it's too late.
Looks like our little guest is awake.
Upon hearing this, Hella gives up pretending to be asleep and sits up, staring warily at the speaker. A young man smiles kindly at her, seemingly unfazed by her hostility.
Great. You look like you're alright.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Who are you? Where am I?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: I'm the ship's captain, <color=#fb9259>Scotch</color>. I'm in charge of the current Cleansing Operation for transport routes.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Don't worry, we've already investigated you. Your identity is vouched for by the MBCC, so you're trustworthy. This ship will return to DisCity after the cleansing, and you can come back with us, but...
Scotch gazes at Hella in anticipation.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Let's have a chat, Miss Sinner. Are you interested in <color=#fb9259>collaborating</color> with us?
On a faraway cliff of WhiteSands, Korryn peeks between the rocks and watches the OAB security team's sand ship sail into the distance.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ah... A step too late. The little mouse got taken away.
Korryn sighs. But her friend is not as sentimental as her.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: What are you sighing for? You're the one who drove her away. Do you like her that much?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yeah, it's been a while since I've met such a cute little girl. Just looking at her makes me happy.
Korryn watches the sand ship from afar, her eyes flickering with thought.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Of course... it would be even better if we could lure her to our side.
